minor_findings.finding: The statement gives 3,930 target-query events and 30 exclusions without explicitly saying that 3,930 is the count after exclusion. The stored count is correct; the sequence can be stated more clearly.

evidence.fact: 4,320 query identities include 360 source query and 3,960 scheduled target query;4,290 included queries comprise 360 source+3,930 target.30 target partials are excluded.
The table labels3,930 target-query rows as included;30 partial-query identities are retained only in the ledger.
All 44 partial source intervals end at the prior-audited EDF boundary; the 30 target-query partials are a subset.

minor_findings.minimal_fix: The target-query endpoint retained 3,930 complete windows after excluding the 30 recording-boundary partial events from 3,960 scheduled target-query identities.

minor_findings.finding: The CSP/LDA descriptions specify covariance and LDA shrinkage but not the fitted class-prior convention, which matters for chronological, class-imbalanced support prefixes. No incorrect prior is claimed, and the public implementation is unambiguous.

evidence.fact: NumPy LDA uses empirical counts from its fitting labels and adds log(counts/counts.sum()) to its discriminant intercept.
Historical Kumar scikit-learn LDA does not override priors.
Matched Kumar LDA does not override priors; it is fitted to source/support union.
The actual installed implementation estimates priors from fitting-label counts when priors is None.
The original phase arms use the same factory/default LDA.

minor_findings.minimal_fix: All CSP/LDA arms estimated LDA class priors from the class frequencies in their own fitting set: source training alone for frozen decoding, and the source/support union for updating arms.
minor_findings.scope_limit: Applies to the CSP/LDA arms, not the separate geometric candidates that explicitly use equal priors.
